# Editorial Image

`editorial/editorial-image` &middot; section-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

A full-width photograph with a caption and credit underneath.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | text |  |
| `credit` | text |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Edge-to-edge image, left-aligned caption.
- **framed**: Inset with side padding and a centered caption. Sets `padding: @spacing.md @theme.section.paddingX`, `captionAlign: center`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `captionAlign` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.md 0"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored. | Fine. Alt text describes the image if blocked. | Caption swaps via dm-muted where honored, image not recolored. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/editorial-image', {
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/600x400/png?text=Terrace",
    "alt": "Guests at a long table on a sunlit terrace"
  },
  "caption": "Lunch on the terrace at the summer shoot in Lisbon.",
  "credit": "Photo: Elena Ruiz"
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "editorial/editorial-image",
  "data": {
    "image": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/600x400/png?text=Terrace",
      "alt": "Guests at a long table on a sunlit terrace"
    },
    "caption": "Lunch on the terrace at the summer shoot in Lisbon.",
    "credit": "Photo: Elena Ruiz"
  }
}
```
